She stops: she doesn't know what "medium confidence" means, whether her edits are saved, or whether policy lets her send a letter the assistant drafted. She needs answers right where she's stuck, without losing the request, and then needs to finish the response before the statutory deadline in 2 business days.

There are 38 responsive documents (212 pages). The 14 suggested redactions fall under three exemptions: personal phone numbers (9), attorney-client privilege (3) and pre-decisional deliberation (2). Three of them are rated medium confidence. Her walkthrough progress is 2 of 5 steps done ("Starting a request" and "Reviewing sources"); still to go are "Redactions," "Policy & sign-off" and "Saving and audit trail." County AI-use policy AP-07 requires a human to approve every redaction and log their name. There are 22 help articles and a named training contact, Luis Ortega in IT, with office hours Tue/Thu 1–3pm.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
